summary.description: Backend-focused Software Engineer with extensive experience in designing, deploying, and optimizing scalable, high-performance systems on AWS. Proven ability in API development, Docker containerization, and performance tuning for complex applications, including robotics, LLM infrastructure, and cloud services. Fluent in both Japanese and English business environments.

backend.technologies: Java, Python, Ruby on Rails, Node.js, Express.js, FastAPI, Spring Boot, Django

about-me.description: I've had the chance to explore a wide range of technologies, from frontend development to full-stack projects and mobile apps, but backend development has always been my true passion. I love diving deep into complex algorithms like quicksort and others, finding immense satisfaction when everything falls into place and runs efficiently. Whether it’s optimizing performance or structuring APIs, there’s nothing quite like the feeling of seeing well-designed code work seamlessly. Now, I’m fully committed to growing as a backend specialist, building on the diverse experiences I've gained to master the art of crafting scalable and reliable systems.

tasks.task: Refactored legacy C++ and web modules to improve maintainability and enforce modular design patterns.
Supported responsive web redesign, optimizing layouts for cross-device usability and accessibility.
Diagnosed and resolved software defects, enhancing system stability and reducing downtime.
Spearheaded containerization of services (LLM infrastructure, robotics simulations, LiDAR perception) using Docker and AWS ECS, streamlining CI/CD workflows.
Optimized and refactored an online meeting and video-call app, boosting performance and maintainability.
Architected and maintained Docker container infrastructure, streamlining CI/CD deployment pipelines.
Developed RESTful backend services for a delivery-robot Android application, ensuring seamless system integration and scalability.
Collaborated closely with design and QA teams—conducting code reviews, writing tests, and delivering high-quality features on schedule.
Reduced user churn by 20% through targeted bug fixes and performance enhancements in the meeting app.
Technologies: Docker, AWS ECS, Nginx, React, TypeScript, Node.js, Express.js, PostgreSQL, Java, Kotlin, Android SDK, Python, C#, C++, ROS 2, A-Frame, JWT, Ruby on Rails
